groups.activity: Uranus Junction, then The Duviri Paradox
conditions: The quest is solo-only, so another player cannot carry this unlock.
bonuses: The same route earns Kullervo's Bane for Kullervo and Pathos Clamps for other Duviri crafting.

groups.activity: The Duviri Experience; Kullervo, then the Orowyrm
conditions: Kullervo's Hold appears only during Anger, Sorrow, and Fear. Check the mood before launching; Joy and Envy cannot pay Bane.
Kullervo and the Orowyrm must both die in the same Spiral. Leaving after either one alone awards zero Bane.
Run The Duviri Experience rather than The Lone Story: the Experience is the consistent Hold route. If The Warden is absent, advance Spiral stages until the Hold is scheduled.
Resource Boosters, Bountiful Harvest, and drop-chance effects do not increase Kullervo's Bane.
bonuses: The first Orowyrm supplies all 10 Pathos Clamps required for Rauta's build.
Use the Undercroft to level gear while farming; solo Alchemy is a commonly fast objective.

disclosures.title: why normal is the recommended farm
disclosures.body: Steel Path gives roughly 50% more Bane, but its extra Orowyrm mechanics and public-squad delays commonly erase that gain. Take normal solo runs, collect a modest number of Decrees, go to the Hold, finish the Orowyrm, and extract.

disclosures.title: the mood clock is the real gate
disclosures.body: Each Duviri mood lasts two hours. Kullervo's Hold is open for three of five moods, so a missed window can mean waiting as long as four hours. Do not rely on old advice that says Envy: Envy does not spawn the Hold.

conditions: Kullervo's Bane is untradeable; Acrithis is the only source for every Rauta blueprint and component.
bonuses: Acrithis also appears in Duviri after a Mood Spiral completes.

conditions: Rauta has no Incarnon Genesis adapter or evolution steps.
